const x = $input.first().json;
return x.route === 'READY' ? [{ json: x }] : [];
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'IS_READY');

// The payload of the single Hermes invocation. Node06 is the only reasoning
// point of this workflow. Nodes 07, 08 and 09 never reason again.
const x = $input.first().json;
const noteRef = 'quant/research-loop/' + x.run_key + '.md';
const state = {
  run_key: x.run_key,
  run_id: x.run_id,
  round_index: x.round_index,
  period_basis: x.period_basis,
  metrics_summary: x.metrics_summary,
  metrics_ref: x.metrics_ref,
  evidence_refs: x.evidence_refs,
  applied_change_set: x.applied_change_set,
  prior_hypothesis_ref: x.prior_hypothesis_ref,
  allowed_override_params: x.allowed_override_params,
  completed_runs: x.completed_runs,
  wiki_state: x.wiki_state
};
const task = [
  'You are the single research turn of the Quant WF-Research 01-12 workflow.',
  'Do both jobs below in this one turn. Do not ask questions. Do not call another agent.',
  '',
  'JOB A (research, in-sample only):',
  '- Use only the in-sample evidence of this run and the prior immutable Wiki note.',
  '- When prior_hypothesis_ref is set, read that Wiki note first (Wiki Brain tools).',
  '- Run your Mixture-of-Agents research over that evidence: several internal',
  '  passes that disagree where the evidence is thin, then one resolved analysis.',
  '- Produce ONE analysis object with EXACTLY these keys: analysis_ref,',
  '  analysis_hash, expectation_vs_actual, lessons, period_basis,',
  '  previous_hypothesis_ref, proposal, source_run_id, source_run_key,',
  '  worth_retesting.',
  '- period_basis must be "IS". source_run_key and source_run_id must equal the',
  '  state below. Round 0 carries previous_hypothesis_ref=null; a later round must',
  '  repeat state.prior_hypothesis_ref exactly.',
  '- analysis_ref must be "hermes-analysis://research-loop/<run_key>/round-<round_index>".',
  '- proposal.source_run_key must equal state.run_key.',
  '- A retest proposal is {"hypothesis_group": "<one group>", "params": {...}}:',
  '  exactly one parameter family, and every parameter name must appear in',
  '  state.allowed_override_params. worth_retesting=true requires a non-empty',
  '  change set; otherwise set proposal.change_set to null.',
  '- expectation_vs_actual and lessons must be non-empty arrays.',
  '- Never put out-of-sample, holdout or forward material in the analysis, and',
  '  never copy raw orders, fills, positions or equity series into it.',
  '- analysis_hash is the lowercase sha256 hex of the exact analysis JSON object',
  '  you persist in JOB B.',
  '',
  'JOB B (persistence, no new reasoning):',
  '- The note path is ' + noteRef + '.',
  '- Read it first (read-before-write). Do not skip this read.',
  '- Absent: write the analysis you just produced to that exact path.',
  '  Reply wiki_ack {"status":"ACK","action":"CREATED",...}.',
  '- Present with the same analysis_hash: write nothing.',
  '  Reply wiki_ack {"status":"ACK","action":"IDEMPOTENT",...}.',
  '- Present with a different analysis_hash: NEVER overwrite.',
  '  Reply wiki_ack {"status":"CONFLICT","action":"REJECTED",',
  '  "existing_analysis_hash":"<the one on disk>"}.',
  '- wiki_ack carries note_ref (= ' + noteRef + '), run_key and analysis_hash.',
  '',
  'STATE (single in-sample run):',
  JSON.stringify(state, null, 2),
  '',
  'FINAL RESPONSE: reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else:',
  '{"analysis": {...}, "wiki_ack": {"status": "...", "action": "...",',
  ' "note_ref": "...", "run_key": "...", "analysis_hash": "..."}}'
].join('\n');
const b64 = Buffer.from(task, 'utf8').toString('base64');
if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$/.test(b64)) { throw new Error('Hermes task payload is not shell-safe'); }
// The only interpolated value is this base64 blob: no shell metacharacter and no
// unescaped input reaches the remote command string.
const command = "printf '%s' '" + b64 + "' | base64 -d | hermes chat --query-file - --oneshot -Q --format stream-json -t wiki_brain";
return [{ json: Object.assign({}, state, {
  payload_kind: 'hermes_task',
  note_ref: noteRef,
  hermes_task_b64: b64,
  hermes_command: command
}) }];
return $input.first().json.route === 'RETEST' ? $input.all() : [];
return $input.first().json.route === 'FINALIZE' ? $input.all() : [];
return $input.first().json.route === 'NEEDS_REVIEW' ? $input.all() : [];
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'RETEST_ROUND');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'OOS_REQUEST');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'NEEDS_REVIEW');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'OOS_ROUND');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'OOS_READY_OK');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'HOLD');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'REJECT');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'PERF_PASS');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'PASS');
return $input.all().filter((entry) => entry.json.route === 'NEEDS_REVIEW');
